title: African Brothers - Youths of Today / Version

lines.l: People wondering where the youths have to find
But they like to see with a youth sometimes
Ain't so, Lord, they like to fight
They like to fight, Lord, fight for the right
Some people, try to keep them down
And you don't like being on the ground
And so, Lord, they'll have to fight
They'll have to fight, Lord, fight for their right
So girl, you better know yourself. I know you'd like to wear. You'd, they want their rights. And so, Lord, they love to fight.
